LOOK_AT.say: A man at the bar with his hat pushed back, entirely at ease, watching the door.
repeat: His boots are good. Everything above the boots isn't, and I've decided that's on purpose.
He's been in the territory a long time and he's leaving it in a very good mood. I'd like whatever he's having.

LISTEN_TO.say: Talking. He's been talking since before I came in, and he hasn't said anything yet.
repeat: Still talking. A lovely voice for saying nothing in.
He's stopped talking. He's looking at me.

options.repeat: Still the newest thing in it. Enjoy it, son. It wears off by Thursday.
options.say: Everybody knows. Small place, and you're the newest thing in it.

options.repeat: Nothing at all. Getting out's free.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: Which is a kind of selling, I suppose.

options.repeat: Claim Two. Producing. Never stopped once. You can ask anybody.
options.say: Claim Two. A producing claim, mind you. It's never once stopped producing. But my sister's poorly, and Sacramento's four days.

options.repeat: Four dollars and the watch. I'm not a greedy man.
There's a claim on it, son, and a claim is where every fortune starts.
options.say: There's a deed on it, son. Your name'll be on it shortly.

options.text: You seem cheerful for a man with a poorly sister.
options.repeat: Still a long way off, son. That's the main thing wrong with her.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: I've made my peace with it.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: She hasn't, but she's a long way off.

options.repeat: Knew him. Past tense's the important bit. Ask the undertaker.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: He raises his glass an inch.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: The undertaker can tell you all about him.

options.repeat: Every word true, son. You'll come to appreciate it.
options.say: I said 'knew', didn't I? I never say a thing that isn't so.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: Pleasure, son. Look after her. She's got character.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: He finishes his drink, collects his hat, and leaves the Nugget.

opening.speaker: deke_vessel

opening.speaker: thad

opening.speaker: deke_vessel
opening.line: It contained a raccoon when I sold it. You bought the whole thing.

options.text: You sold me a worthless claim.
options.say: I sold you a claim. Worth is your department. Mine's volume.

options.text: I want my four dollars back.
options.say: They're working, son. Money works out here.

options.text: Teach me to lie like that.
options.say: Can't teach it. Can demonstrate it.
I answer for it constantly. Nobody accepts the answer.

repeats.say: Still answering, son. I've got the answer down very nice by now.

options.say: Every man does, son. It's what keeps me in practice. Pull up the chair; the judges are getting bored.

options.text: I need you to sign an affidavit.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: Sign a paper saying I sold you mud under false pretenses? Son, that's a confession with a stamp on it.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: Tell you what. We'll settle it the local way.

options.text: Thank you. This has been clarifying.
